derivation: (Aramaic) corresponding to H5367 (נָקַשׁ); used in the sense of H5362 (נָקַף);

occurrences.text: Then the king’s countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.
